scope: Read-only source/evidence diagnosis after the paired physical oracle. No new controller, learner, training, evaluation job, checkpoint mutation, or task-goal change was executed. Conditional next diagnostic only; finish the already-running fixed751 exploration repair first.

gpu_physical_oracle.limit: Privileged geometric control supports sampled reachability, not visual learnability. Nine xm approach timeouts remain unresolved.

final_corrected_reward_continuations.limit: One training seed, mixed100-update old/651-update bootstrap-corrected sources, same-seed numerical repeats are not independent experiments.

visibility.limit: Pixel differences in a Native renderer diagnostic establish available cues in those sampled images, not correct GPU classification or sub2mm localization by the learned actor.

actor_critic_information.actor: Both arms measured joints and velocities, own actuator/TCP/gimbal targets, fixed calibration, elapsed time, uint8 wrist/external RGB. No object pose, socket goal or variant label.
actor_critic_information.critic: Actor proprio plus object/TCP/tip pose, corrected body goal, object velocity and occlusion state. Privileged critic goal contains the hidden offset; critic competence does not establish actor perception.
actor_critic_information.encoder: Separate32-channel spatial-softmax CNNs output64 coordinates/view, followed by shared GRU128 and MLP128128. Coordinates do not explicitly retain feature confidence; learnability limitations are unproven. Historical successful actors also used spatial-softmax.

action_goal_convention.success: Body rawfreejoint qpos error strictly<2mm for3consecutive25Hz samples, not TCP error.
action_goal_convention.assessment: Source goal sign/grip convention is consistent with the unchanged controller that achieves503/512. No universal action-box or goal-sign bug was found. Correct mapping does not establish learned-policy tracking precision.

exploration_precision.limit: Requested target variability is not actual body error: clipping, rate limits, IK, contacts and deterministic mean-action evaluation intervene. Std contraction is descriptive, not proof of why variant learning fails.

reward.progress: 3*(phi_next-phi_old)+10*held3-.005-.0005*sum(action^2)/3; phi=exp(-xy/.035)+exp(-xy/.008)*exp(-abs(z)/.025). Progress shaping uses derived positions; physical success uses current qpos.
cautions: Neither completed profile solves all variants; their scales are incomparable.
Progress delta is phi_next-phi_old, while PPO gamma=.99. This is not the gamma-consistent potential-based-shaping formula; whether the distinction impedes learning is unmeasured.
Action cost penalizes absolute normalized target requests, not actual physical displacement; any workspace-center preference must be measured before calling it a cause.

recurrent_credit.limit: BPTT cannot cross collector boundaries, but this does not establish lost information or discarded delayed reward. Fixed-view failure makes camera credit alone an incomplete account.

historical_comparison.other_changes: Historical5s horizon/.022s step, instantaneous success/log reward, feedforward256256128,96x96 images, actor6-channel fused camera input in dual-view cases, differentIK damping/maxdq and prong-derived inertia versus current equalized inertia. Stored training success cannot identify which change matters.

prioritized_hypotheses.hypothesis: Actor visual state estimation or use fails to recover socket location and the15mm variant correction reliably.
prioritized_hypotheses.support: Large oracle-versus-learned gap on paired physical/sensor starts; actor must infer both from RGB, and learned successes concentrate on xp. Pixel-cue existence is weaker than useful learned features.
prioritized_hypotheses.next_measurement: On one frozen final checkpoint, record the actual actor inputs, CNN features and recurrent output already consumed during a single balanced512-episode firstdone evaluation. Compare decoded absolute TCP requests and processed target XY with the known socket/variant-corrected target by phase; report pervariant signed residuals and nearest-variant-target confusion. Retain prespecified image/feature snapshots rather than selected success/failure examples only.
prioritized_hypotheses.falsification: Variant-dependent commands and socket-dependent target localization are accurate in failures; then perception alone cannot explain them. A constant or wrong target mapping does not by itself prove the CNN lacks recoverable information.

prioritized_hypotheses.hypothesis: Even correctly estimated goals are converted into an imprecise or poorly ordered approach/descend policy.
prioritized_hypotheses.support: Sub2mm held3 success, absolute action box/rate limits, contracted or large target-noise scales, asymmetric xm approach hard region.
prioritized_hypotheses.next_measurement: Use the same512 captures to separate raw actor request, processed TCP target, derived actual TCP tracking, current body XY/Z error and hold history. Compare late approach/descent windows, command saturation, wrong z timing and terminal bias; list the oracle nine hard worlds separately.
prioritized_hypotheses.falsification: Policy requests and tracking achieve the intended XY/Z trajectory with currentqpos body error strictly below2mm for three consecutive audited samples, yet termination is false; that would require a new success audit rather than a policy repair.

prioritized_hypotheses.hypothesis: Recurrent credit, reward incentives or insufficient optimization exposure contribute after state-estimation/control diagnostics are understood.
prioritized_hypotheses.support: 24step BPTT shorter than inspection and insertion; delta shaping conventions differ; historical configured global exposure is about21.3times current751.
prioritized_hypotheses.next_measurement: Inspect phase-specific reward components and command errors first. A longer-rollout comparison remains PREPARED_NOT_EXECUTABLE until rollout settings and cumulative transition/resume/telemetry accounting are refactored. Historical exposure is a limitation, not authorization for a21times extension.
prioritized_hypotheses.falsification: A direct source/evidence localization/control failure would take precedence over more rollout or budget trials.

one_bounded_next_diagnostic.decision: Choose one narrow repair only after this decomposition. Keep transfer/push and active-perception benefit claims gated on physical allvariant competence; fixed-view diagnosis precedes utility comparisons.
